verdict.rationale: A separate sandbox, test project, or dev environment is a fair capability to expect from an analytics SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents an isolated environment that keeps test data out of production. The wizard's 'test event' (amplitude-docs-1) is sent to the user's configured project, and feature-flag rollouts (amplitude-docs-19) target real users, so neither is a sandbox.
